Rome, Italy

The Roman Forum is a forum surrounded by the ruins of several important ancient government buildings. Citizens of the ancient city referred to this space, originally a marketplace, as the Forum Magnum, or simply the Forum. The teeming heart of ancient Rome, it is located in the small valley between the Palatine and Capitoline Hills. Many of the oldest and most important structures of the ancient city were located on or near the Forum.
